description: Machine format (wr.calls.v1, testnet): the full sealed envelope for one call id (e.g. ep.6). Use calls_list first if you do not have a call_id. Returns the full sealed envelope object for that call. An unknown call_id returns an error; if the store file is absent on this deployment, it returns {call: null, note} instead. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication; every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, query, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).

call_id.description: Call id, as returned by calls_list or calls_since, e.g. ep.6.

name: calls_get
title: Get One Call (Machine Format)
